amendments_considered.what_changed: Amendment No. 1 (Dec 23, 2022; full A&R Annex A): leverage schedule raised (3.75 to 3/31/2023, 4.75, 5.00, 4.75, 4.50, 4.25, 3.75, then 3.25 from 9/28/2024).

Amendment No. 2 (Jun 20, 2023; full A&R Annex A): leverage 5.50 to 6/30/2023, N/A for two quarters, 6.25 stepping to 3.25 from 7/1/2025; added Minimum Covenant Liquidity $2,000M through 9/27/2024 and minimum Free Cash Flow through 12/29/2023; Annualized EBITDA for three 2024 quarters.
Amendment No. 3 (Jun 11, 2024): Excluded Property / Great Oaks sale-leaseback only; no covenant change.
Amendment No. 4 (Feb 20, 2025; conformed agreement): Term A-3 loans; Section 6.24 schedule unchanged; Total Funded Debt drops the 2024 Convertible Notes Early Refinancing proviso.
Amendment No. 5 (May 21, 2025): 'Open Market Purchase' wording only; no covenant change.
Amendment No. 6 (Feb 5, 2026): notes naming and debt basket (ll); no covenant change.

draft_notes: Leverage thresholds use the contract's period start/end dates as written (WDC fiscal quarters end on Fridays, e.g. 2024-03-29), not test dates. The latest table (Amendment No. 2, carried into Amendment No. 4) restates the full history; evidence quotes are from the Amendment No. 4 conformed agreement.
First row starts at the 'Amendment and Restatement Effective Date'; recorded as 2022-01-07 (Restatement Agreement date), not separately verified.
Leverage covenant is N/A for 2023-07-01 to 2023-12-29 (two quarters): no threshold entries for that gap.
Section 6.24(a)(ii): after a Leverage Ratio Covenant Notice the max becomes 3.25x (optional election; ignored). Qualified Acquisition step-up ignored.
Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA is replaced by 'Annualized EBITDA' for the leverage test at FQs ending 2024-03-29, 2024-06-28, 2024-09-27; Annualized EBITDA not labeled.
Min liquidity effective_from = Amendment No. 2 Effective Date, assumed 2023-06-20 (amendment date). Test is at each Fiscal Quarter End Date.

Minimum Free Cash Flow covenant (Section 6.24(d): $(550.0)M Apr 1-Jun 30 2023, $(500.0)M Jul 1-Sep 29 2023, $(500.0)M Sep 30-Dec 29 2023) intentionally NOT labeled: the Free Cash Flow definition does not state its measurement period, so test_period would be a guess.

The (viii)+(xii)+Pro Forma Adjustment add-back cap is 'greater of $500 million and 15% of Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA' and is shared across both items; modeled as cap pct_of 0.15 plus cap_alt abs $500M (greater_of).
Total Funded Debt children reference clauses of 'Indebtedness' not expanded here.
